','Hasta los detalles pequeños terminan significando mucho.'],
  ['data:image/webp;base64,','Otra noche juntos, otra foto que queda para siempre.']
].map(([src,caption])=>({src,caption}));
let galleryIndex=0;
let pointerStart=null;
const albumImage=$('#albumImage'),albumBlur=$('#albumBlur'),albumCaption=$('#albumCaption'),albumCount=$('#albumCount'),albumThumbs=$('#albumThumbs');
const lightbox=$('#lightbox'),lightboxImage=$('#lightboxImage'),lightboxCaption=$('#lightboxCaption'),lightboxCount=$('#lightboxCount');

gallery.forEach((item,i)=>{
  const b=document.createElement('button');
  b.type='button';b.className='album-thumb'+(i===0?' active':'');b.setAttribute('aria-label',`Ver foto ${i+1}`);
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=item.src;img.alt='';b.appendChild(img);
  b.addEventListener('click',()=>setGallery(i));albumThumbs.appendChild(b);
});
function renderGallery(animate=true){
  const item=gallery[galleryIndex];
  if(animate&&albumImage.animate)albumImage.animate([{opacity:.55,transform:'scale(.992)'},{opacity:1,transform:'scale(1)'}],{duration:220,easing:'ease-out'});
  albumImage.src=item.src;albumBlur.style.backgroundImage=`url('${item.src}')`;albumCaption.textContent=item.caption;albumCount.textContent=`${String(galleryIndex+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${String(gallery.length).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  $$('.album-thumb',albumThumbs).forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('active',i===galleryIndex));
  albumThumbs.children[galleryIndex]?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',inline:'center',block:'nearest'});
  if(lightbox.open)renderLightbox();
}
function setGallery(i,animate=true){galleryIndex=(i+gallery.length)%gallery.length;renderGallery(animate)}
function moveGallery(delta){setGallery(galleryIndex+delta);vibrate(5)}
$('#albumPrev').addEventListener('click',()=>moveGallery(-1));$('#albumNext').addEventListener('click',()=>moveGallery(1));
$('#albumStage').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();moveGallery(-1)}else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();moveGallery(1)}else if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();openLightbox()}});
$('#albumStage').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{pointerStart={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}});
$('#albumStage').addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{
  if(!pointerStart)return;
  const dx=e.clientX-pointerStart.x,dy=e.clientY-pointerStart.y;pointerStart=null;
  if(Math.abs(dx)>55&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.15)moveGallery(dx<0?1:-1);
});
$('#albumStage').addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>pointerStart=null);

function renderLightbox(){const item=gallery[galleryIndex];lightboxImage.src=item.src;lightboxCaption.textContent=item.caption;lightboxCount.textContent=`${galleryIndex+1} / ${gallery.length}`}
function openLightbox(){renderLightbox();if(typeof lightbox.showModal==='function')lightbox.showModal();else lightbox.setAttribute('open','')}
function closeLightbox(){if(typeof lightbox.close==='function'&&lightbox.open)lightbox.close();else lightbox.removeAttribute('open')}
$('#albumOpen').addEventListener('click',openLightbox);$('#lightboxClose').addEventListener('click',closeLightbox);$('#lightboxPrev').addEventListener('click',()=>moveGallery(-1));$('#lightboxNext').addEventListener('click',()=>moveGallery(1));
lightbox.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===lightbox)closeLightbox()});

$$('#wordConstellation button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $$('#wordConstellation button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');$('#wordMessage').textContent=btn.dataset.message;vibrate(7);
}));

const envelope=$('#envelope'),letterSeal=$('#letterSeal'),letterPaper=$('#letterPaper');
letterSeal.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(envelope.classList.contains('is-open'))return;
  envelope.classList.add('is-open');letterSeal.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');letterPaper.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');vibrate(12);
  setTimeout(()=>letterPaper.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}),600);
});

const finalMeter=$('#finalMeter');
const finalHold=makeHold($('#finalHold'),{
  duration:1450,
  onProgress:p=>finalMeter.style.width=`${p*100}%`,
  onComplete:()=>{
    if(finalOpened)return;
    finalOpened=true;
    document.body.classList.add('is-final');
    const finale=$('#finale');finale.classList.add('is-unlocked');finale.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');launchHearts();
    setTimeout(()=>finale.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}),100);
  }
});
function launchHearts(){
  const holder=$('#floatingHearts');holder.replaceChildren();
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++)setTimeout(()=>{
    const h=document.createElement('span');h.className='heart-float';h.textContent=Math.random()>.32?'♡':'♥';h.style.left=`${3+Math.random()*94}%`;h.style.setProperty('--size',`${14+Math.random()*19}px`);h.style.setProperty('--dur',`${5+Math.random()*3.5}s`);holder.appendChild(h);h.addEventListener('animationend',()=>h.remove());
  },i*90);
}

$('#replay').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  setTimeout(()=>{
    finalOpened=false;document.body.classList.remove('is-final');$('#finale').classList.remove('is-unlocked');$('#finale').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');finalHold.reset();
    envelope.classList.remove('is-open');letterSeal.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');letterPaper.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    $$('.memory-entry').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('is-open'));$$('.disclosure').forEach(b=>{b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');b.querySelector('span').textContent='Descubrir recuerdo'});
    $$('#wordConstellation button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));$('#wordMessage').textContent='Toca una de las palabras';
    setGallery(0,false);music.pause();music.currentTime=0;syncAudioUI();audioDock.classList.remove('is-visible');floatingHeader.classList.remove('is-visible');
    experienceOpened=false;opening.classList.remove('is-open');document.body.classList.add('is-locked');openHold.reset();
  },560);
});

window.__LC_QA__={
  setGallery,moveGallery,openLightbox,closeLightbox,toggleMusic,
  forceOpen(){openHold.complete()},
  forceFinal(){finalHold.complete()},
  get galleryIndex(){return galleryIndex},get experienceOpened(){return experienceOpened},get finalOpened(){return finalOpened}
};
if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('preview')){experienceOpened=true;opening.classList.add('is-open');document.body.classList.remove('is-locked');floatingHeader.classList.add('is-visible');audioDock.classList.add('is-visible')}
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
